## Change and publication scope

State each case slug and whether it enters the gallery or remains explicitly
unlisted. Link both language routes for a gallery change.

## Verification

- [ ] Followed [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/dcc-mcp/showcase/blob/main/AGENTS.md); recorded actual model IDs, reasoning settings and exact host/adapter/Core versions, with unknowns explained.
- [ ] Updated collection/locales or the explicit unlisted reason, plus artifact hashes.
- [ ] Reported checks, rights, privacy and remaining failures without changing their historical scope.
- [ ] Checked current-head CI and review. Deployment and live-page verification will be reported separately after merge.
